Latin word

historia

historia, historiae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

history: an account of the past, and its study

In this lexicon

  • history

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 2.36; Cic. Fin. 5.5; Traupman 29, 328

Examples

  • historia vērō testis temporum, lūx vēritātis, vīta memoriae, magistra vītae, nūntia vetustātis

    history, the witness of the ages, the light of truth, the life of memory, the teacher of life, the messenger of antiquityCic. de Or. 2.36

    In the entry for history

  • quācumque enim ingredimur, in aliquā historiā vestīgium pōnimus

    for wherever we walk, we set foot on some piece of historyCic. Fin. 5.5
